title: Splitter
description: An entity which distributes items across transport belts.

input_priority.description: What side the splitter should prioritize it's input, or none if there should be no prioritization.

output_priority.description: What side the splitter should prioritize it's output, or none if there should be no prioritization.

set_input_side.title: Set Input Priority
set_input_side.description: Whether or not this splitter should use a connected circuit network when determining which input side to prioritize.

input_left_condition.title: Input Left Condition
input_left_condition.description: What condition should make the splitter prefer inputs from it's left side.

input_right_condition.title: Input Right Condition
input_right_condition.description: What condition should make the splitter prefer inputs from it's right side.

set_output_side.title: Set Output Priority
set_output_side.description: Whether or not this splitter should use a connected circuit network when determining which output side to prioritize.

output_left_condition.title: Output Left Condition
output_left_condition.description: What condition should make the splitter prefer outputs from it's left side.

output_right_condition.title: Output Right Condition
output_right_condition.description: What condition should make the splitter prefer outputs from it's right side.

set_filter.title: Set Filter
set_filter.description: Whether or not this splitter should use the circuit network to determine the item filter applied to the prioritized output. If multiple signals are present, `any` signal is chosen.

filter.title: Item Filter
filter.description: What item this splitter should filter on the `output_priority` side. If this value is set but `output_priority` is omitted, `output_priority` defaults to `'left'`
